protocol: Sequential fresh processes; clean output each run; one recorded first-use run, then five or more measured repetitions; OS/dependency caches retained; RSS process-tree sampled every 5ms; gzip level 9; no watch, installation, typecheck, Docker or resource copy in compilation timing
sanitization: Only ANSI color escapes and absolute workspace/temporary-output prefixes in compiler failure diagnostics were normalized after measurement; timings, sizes and memory values are unchanged.
scope: Backend shortlist only; public-fixture browser scenarios are in web-results.json.
